style_en: Vertical 9:16 miniature diorama 3D CG render in an empty white space. Smooth faceless figurines (no eyes, nose or mouth details). Soft shadows, slightly high angle. Mostly white and gray, only key objects red. Calm, clinical, never violent. Keep the top 35% of the frame empty white space with no heads or objects; place the main subject between 35% and 68% of the height, centered.
avoid_en: logos, badges, insignia or emblems of real agencies, readable text or numbers, detailed national flags, blood, wounds, people being shot, a target person, faces resembling real people
